title: Agent Chat: raise/relax the 24-step cap so long tasks complete (configurable, keep a backstop)
description:
FIXED (task 1305).

CAP: DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS=100 (was 24) in agentLoop.ts. Configurable via new 'agentMaxSteps' preference, surfaced as a 'Max steps' control in AgentSettings; clamped to [MIN_MAX_STEPS=1, MAX_STEPS_LIMIT=1000] by clampMaxSteps() so it is NEVER truly unbounded (backstop preserved per 1282). Threaded AgentChatPanel maxSteps prop -> runAgentTurn -> stopWhen: stepCountIs(maxSteps).

CAP-REACHED UX: new terminal AgentRunStatus 'max-steps'. The reducer (reduceAgentEvent 'finish') detects it via finishReason==='tool-calls' on the top-level fullStream finish (AI SDK reports the LAST step's reason; natural completion is 'stop', a cap hit mid-tool-calls is 'tool-calls'). AgentChatPanel renders a clear amber 'Reached the step limit before finishing...' line + a 'Continue' button (data-testid=agent-continue) on the last turn when idle, which resumes the same thread with full history and a fresh step budget. Stop button untouched/working.

TESTS: agentLoop.test.ts +6 (cap value >=100 & bounded; clampMaxSteps fallback/clamp; max-steps terminal on finishReason tool-calls; done preserved on stop; abort outranks max-steps). All 903 @flash/authoring-ui unit tests pass (0 failures). agent-chat e2e oracles pass: agent-chat-drives-stage.spec.ts (1 passed) + agent-chat-panel-regression.spec.ts (4 passed). pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green.

Code-review (medium) confirmed finishReason detection sound; fixed one found UI-consistency bug (commitSteps now clamps before persist so displayed==enforced cap).
